csv-parse 5.6.0 -> 7.0.2. Call site unchanged: csv-parse/sync subpath and relax_quotes/relax_column_count/skip_empty_lines all survive in 7.x. Verified byte-identical parseProfiles output over a new fixture before/after the bump; that comparison is now test/sheet-parse.test.ts (offline, fetch stubbed, HOME redirected). Also cleared the last LOW by updating body-parser 2.2.2 -> 2.3.0. bun run audit now reports 0 advisories. Added 'test' and 'audit' scripts to package.json.

Two layers: src/fellow/client.ts now encodes each interpolated id with a seg() helper (encodeURIComponent) at all five request sites, and src/schemas.ts adds ResourceIdSchema (letters/digits/dot/underscore/colon/hyphen, max 128, no dot segments) wired into aiden.getDevice, listProfiles, createProfile, updateProfile, deleteProfile. Dots are allowed since real serials may use them, but '.', '..' and any embedded '..' are rejected. Error messages left unencoded so they stay readable. test/resource-id.test.ts covers accept and reject cases; typecheck, lint, and bun test all clean.

Added src/sheet/url.ts with assertAllowedSheetUrl: https-only, no credentials in URL, hostname must be in getSheetHostAllowlist() (default docs.google.com; operators extend via AIDEN_AI_SHEET_ALLOWED_HOSTS, the model cannot). store.sync now fetches through fetchAllowedSheet, which uses redirect:'manual' and re-checks every hop against the allowlist, capped at SHEET_MAX_REDIRECTS=3. Also stopped echoing the upstream error body into the thrown message (partial nh5.10). test/sheet-url.test.ts covers metadata IP, loopback, suffix lookalike (docs.google.com.evil.example), credentialed URL, http downgrade, file://, off-allowlist redirect, and redirect loop. Threat model updated.

Decision: the model may not choose the fetch target. Removed csvUrl from sheet.sync's inputSchema entirely — the tool now takes {} and the URL comes only from AIDEN_AI_SHEET_CSV_URL or the default const. Verified over a real stdio tools/list handshake: sheet.sync advertises an empty properties object. The response still reports the URL actually fetched. Operator-supplied env URLs are not exempt from the allowlist; test covers that. Threat model S2 updated.

Replaced keytar with OS credential CLI shell-out (security/secret-tool) + AES-256-GCM envelope for the session blob; keytar removed from package.json and lockfile, no install scripts remain. Reasoning recorded in docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.

Bounded profile schemas to real Aiden firmware ranges (temps 50-99 step .5, ratio 14-20, bloom 1-120s, pulses 1-10 / 5-60s, title charset+50 chars), plus pulse-array length and count cross-checks. Tests in test/profile-limits.test.ts.
sheet.list/sheet.search wrap output in untrusted-data delimiters, defang forged markers, stamp dataTrust, standing note in descriptions; injection fixture tests added
sheet cells now pass through src/sheet/sanitize.ts: ANSI/control/zero-width stripped, length capped (200 text, 120 title), brewing fields range-checked; failing fields dropped, titleless rows dropped
Sheet fetch now bounded: shared AbortController deadline over redirect chain + body read, 2 MB streamed byte cap, text/csv|text/plain content-type gate. Tests in test/sheet-fetch-bounds.test.ts.
getAppDataDir() now honours AIDEN_AI_DATA_DIR; all sheet tests point at a temp dir through it instead of process.env.HOME, which Bun's os.homedir() ignores.
start() connects the stdio transport before warming the sheet; warmCache() is fire-and-forget and never rejects; getProfiles() waits on an in-flight warm only when no cache exists.

parseProfiles now passes max_record_size and to: SHEET_MAX_ROWS+1 to csv-parse, and rejects over-cap row/column counts with a clear error instead of truncating. Tests in test/sheet-parse-limits.test.ts.

Upstream error bodies no longer quoted into thrown messages (upstreamError + login-specific reason); plaintext session storage now requires AIDEN_AI_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_SESSION and warns on every write; threat model updated. Tests in test/credential-hygiene.test.ts.

Install policy documented in CONTRIBUTING.md + docs/DEPENDENCIES.md; scripts/check-install-scripts.mjs enforces no install scripts; CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs frozen no-script install, lockfile-drift assert, script check, advisory audit (push/PR + daily cron), typecheck, tests.
